appearance_facts.fact: The largest visible wedge, colored orange-red, occupies the largest angular extent of the chart.
A red wedge is the second-largest visible extent, smaller than the upper-right wedge.
A pale-yellow wedge is smaller than the red wedge.
An orange wedge is the smallest visible extent.
Four slices partition the full circle; the upper-right slice clearly dominates the others in apparent area.
